title: Conveyancing Paralegal
description:
Residential Conveyancing Paralegal

Location: Glasgow
Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience
Contract: Full-time, Permanent

About the Role:

We are seeking an experienced and motivated Residential Conveyancing Paralegal to join our client, a well-established legal firm based in Glasgow. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a strong background in conveyancing who is looking to develop their career within a supportive and dynamic environment.

Key Responsibilities:
- Managing a caseload of residential conveyancing matters from instruction to completion.
- Drafting and reviewing legal documents, including contracts and title deeds.
- Liaising with clients, estate agents, lenders, and other third parties to ensure smooth transactions.
- Conducting property searches and handling Land Registry applications.
- Maintaining accurate records and ensuring compliance with all regulatory requirements.

About You:
- Previous experience in residential conveyancing is essential.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple files effectively.
- Excellent communication skills and a client-focused approach.
- Proficiency in case management systems and Microsoft Office.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Benefits:
- Competitive salary and benefits package.
- Opportunities for career progression and professional development.
- Supportive and collaborative working environment.

How to Apply:

Please submit an up to date copy of your CV or get in touch with Zoe King at Reed for more information.

title: Legal Secretary
description:
Role: Legal Secretary
Location: Glasgow
Salary range: £27,000 - £30,000 DOE
Full-Time Permanent

A well-established Scottish law firm is seeking an experienced Legal Secretary to join its Commercial Property team in Glasgow.

The successful candidate will provide dedicated support to a Solicitor handling a broad range of commercial property matters. This opportunity would suit an experienced legal secretary with a strong understanding of Scottish property transactions and previous exposure to commercial property work.

Key Responsibilities
- Providing comprehensive secretarial support to a Property Solicitor.
- Assisting with commercial property transactions from inception through to completion.
- Preparing and formatting legal documents and correspondence.
- Managing diaries, appointments and client communications.
- Maintaining accurate records using legal case management systems.
- Liaising with clients, solicitors and third parties throughout transactions.
- General administrative support to ensure the smooth running of the department.

Skills & Experience Required
- Previous experience as a Legal Secretary within a Scottish legal environment.
- Essential experience supporting commercial property transactions.
- Strong knowledge of the Scottish conveyancing and property process.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
- Experience using legal case management systems.
- Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
- Strong communication and client service abilities.

What's on Offer
- Salary of £27,000 - £30,000 depending on experience.
- Friendly and supportive working environment.
- Bank and public holidays, plus office closure between Christmas and New Year.
- Opportunity to join a respected and growing Scottish legal practice.

If you are an experienced Legal Secretary with a commercial property background and are considering your next move, we'd be keen to hear from you.

title: Paralegal
description:
Paralegal - RTA Litigation

Location: Glasgow
Salary: £30,000 - £40,000 DOE
Working Pattern: Hybrid (2 days office / 3 days home)

About the Role

An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced Paralegal to join a well-established and highly regarded Personal Injury team based in Glasgow.

The successful candidate will be responsible for managing a caseload of litigated Pursuer Road Traffic Accident (RTA) claims, progressing files efficiently while delivering a high standard of client care throughout the claims process. This role offers the opportunity to work within a supportive team environment while managing your own caseload and contributing to the continued success of the department.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage a caseload of approximately 60-80 litigated Pursuer RTA claims.
- Progress claims from medical evidence stage through to settlement.
- Draft court pleadings, motions, and other legal documentation.
- Prepare and submit court productions and supporting documentation.
- Assess and calculate clients' losses and supporting evidence.
- Conduct liability and quantum reviews.
- Negotiate settlements with insurers and third-party representatives.
- Maintain regular communication with clients, ensuring exceptional levels of client care.
- Liaise with medical agencies, counsel, court personnel, insurers and other stakeholders.
- Ensure all files are progressed in line with court deadlines and internal procedures.
- Accurately update the case management system and maintain file records.
- Identify matters requiring escalation to a Solicitor or Team Leader.
- Contribute positively to team objectives and departmental performance.

Skills & Experience Required

Essential
- Previous experience within a Personal Injury litigation environment.
- Experience managing your own caseload.
- Strong understanding of the Scottish litigation process.
- Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
- Strong organisational and time management abilities.
- Ability to prioritise workloads and meet deadlines.
- High level of attention to detail and accuracy.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office and case management systems.
- Strong client care and relationship management skills.

Desirable
- Experience handling Pursuer RTA litigation files.
- Knowledge of the Compulsory Pre-Action Protocol (CPAP).
- Experience preparing court pleadings and productions.
- Familiarity with Sheriff Court procedures.

Personal Attributes
- Professional and proactive approach.
- Strong problem-solving skills.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Resilient and adaptable within a fast-paced environment.
- Committed to delivering exceptional client service.
- Positive and collaborative attitude.

Benefits
- Competitive salary package.
- Hybrid working arrangement.
- Annual loyalty bonus.
- Individual performance bonus scheme.
- Discretionary company bonus.
- Ongoing training and development opportunities.
- Supportive and collaborative working environment.
- Opportunity for career progression within an established and growing legal practice.

Bonus Scheme

Loyalty Bonus
- £500 annual payment upon completion of the financial year.

Individual Performance Bonus
- 2% of fees generated above £250,000 (pro rata).

Discretionary Bonus
- Additional company performance-related bonus.
